cases.expectation: Preserve both quoted identifiers and the real negative contrast. The 500 ms alert condition must not govern the independent 200 ms sampling interval. Respect explicit line-separated constraints without inventing code, implementation steps or executing the instructions.

sourceItems: Uh, keep the key `traceID` exactly as it is. Do not rename it to `traceId`.
If the retry takes more than three seconds, record a warning. The polling interval should stay at two hundred milliseconds regardless of that retry.
Please list these constraints as separate bullet points.
